svg.text: ISO Enter is L-shaped (1.5 top, 1.25 bottom) and cannot be built
Gaps replace the 0.25/0.75 remainders; space bar becomes 2+1 thumb keys per side
B: universal ANSI / ISO / JIS / ABNT2, buildable (94 keys), recommended
Blue = key whose legend or role changes with the language; no gaps in the main block
